description: Land Acquisition - Pasyala, Merrigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - (order No. 01/2020)
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and ownership claims. The document is an order authorizing the taking of possession of these lands, which falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). While it mentions a government minister, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose and does not involve government structural changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
